<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Undo the last transaction.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo undo [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | Undo even if its files changed since; those edits are lost. |

## Global options

`--root`, `--json` and `--no-input` work here too; see [global options](/reference/cli/#global-options).
